epic.title: Parent Exam & Result Oversight Module
epic.body: Provides parents with a comprehensive view of their children's examination schedules, detailed performance results, and subject-wise grade distributions for informed academic monitoring.

features.title: Exam Schedule Visibility
features.body: Allows parents to track upcoming exam dates, subjects, and durations for their children to assist in academic preparation.

stories.title: Student Exam Timeline Interface
stories.body: Display a list of scheduled examinations for the selected child, including specific dates and subjects.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Display exam cards showing Exam Title (e.g., Mid-Term 2026) and description.
Nested Schedule: Ability to expand an exam to see a detailed schedule (Date, Subject, Max Marks, Duration).
Context: Automatically update the exam list when switching between child profiles.
Status: Clearly distinguish between 'Upcoming' and 'Completed' exams.

stories.title: Student Examination Retrieval API
stories.body: API endpoints to serve exam schedules and metadata for students associated with the authenticated parent.
acceptanceCriteria: List: GET endpoint to fetch exams for a specific studentId based on their class enrollment.
Security: Validate parent-child relationship before returning academic schedules.
Read: Include subject-wise schedule arrays in the exam object response.

features.title: Detailed Results & Grading
features.body: Enables parents to view subject-specific marks, percentages, and overall grades for completed assessments.

stories.title: Exam Performance Cards
stories.body: As a parent, I want to see result cards showing my child's performance in individual exams.
acceptanceCriteria: Summary: Show cards with 'Total Marks', 'Obtained Marks', and 'Overall Percentage'.
Grading: Display the overall grade (e.g., A+, B) as determined by the system logic.
Subject Breakdown: Provide a table or list showing marks obtained in each specific subject within the exam.
Rank: Display the student's rank within their class for the specific exam.

stories.title: Academic Result & Analytics API
stories.body: Backend logic to serve student-specific grades and aggregate performance metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Read: GET endpoint to retrieve graded marks for a studentId and examId.
Analytics: Provide calculated percentage and class rank for the parent view.
Consistency: Ensure the backend serves status (Pass/Fail) based on institute-defined grading rules.

features.title: Academic Dashboard Integration
features.body: High-level summary of exam performance directly on the main parent dashboard.

stories.title: Dashboard Performance Overview
stories.body: Visual indicator on the dashboard showing the child's average academic performance.
acceptanceCriteria: Display: Show an 'Avg Marks' card on the parent dashboard for the selected child.
Navigation: Clicking the performance card navigates the parent to the detailed Exams/Results screen.
